en.text: Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你听闻公义，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你聽聞公義，

en.text: Let my sentence come out of your presence. your eyes look on equity.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的判语从你面前发出；

zhTraditional.text: 願我的判語從你面前發出；

en.text: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.
As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

zhSimplified.text: 论到人的行为，我借着你嘴唇的言语自己谨守，

zhTraditional.text: 論到人的行為，我藉着你嘴唇的言語自己謹守，

en.text: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

zhSimplified.text: 我的脚踏定了你的路径；

zhTraditional.text: 我的腳踏定了你的路徑；

en.text: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，我曾求告你，因为你必应允我；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，我曾求告你，因為你必應允我；

en.text: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 求你显出你奇妙的慈爱来；

zhTraditional.text: 求你顯出你奇妙的慈愛來；

en.text: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

zhSimplified.text: 求你保护我，如同保护眼中的瞳人；

zhTraditional.text: 求你保護我，如同保護眼中的瞳人；

en.text: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

zhSimplified.text: 使我脱离那欺压我的恶人，

zhTraditional.text: 使我脫離那欺壓我的惡人，

en.text: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他们围困了我们的脚步；

zhTraditional.text: 他們圍困了我們的腳步；

en.text: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你起来，前去迎敌，将他打倒！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你起來，前去迎敵，將他打倒！

en.text: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你用手救我脱离人，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你用手救我脫離人，

en.text: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

zhSimplified.text: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面； 你的形象就心满意足了。

zhTraditional.text: 至於我，我必在義中見你的面； 你的形像就心滿意足了。
